In this role, you will contribute across backend and front-end development, apply modern engineering practices, and help deliver secure, scalable, and maintainable technology solutions. Work you'll do

* Designing, developing, and maintaining backend services and application programming interfaces using Java, Spring, Spring Boot, and microservices architecture
* Building and enhancing React applications using TypeScript, modern JavaScript, and integration with RESTful or GraphQL services
* Evaluating solution options, identifying risks, and contributing to secure, scalable, and maintainable design decisions
* Performing testing, debugging, defect management, documentation, and production issue resolution across the software development lifecycle

Location: Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai, Pune
  
  
Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM or 2 PM to 11 PM IST
  
  
**Qualifications**

* Core JAVA & Backend engineering :
* 6-10 years of strong hands-on experience in JAVA( 8 +) with solid grounding in Object-Oriented design principles and clean coding practices including identifying design flaws in existing codebases and refactoring towards maintainable designs

* Spring & Enterprise Frameworks:
* Strong understanding of microservices architecture , with the ability able to design high-level service boundaries, ensure effective inter-service communication and manage data consistency
* Hands-on experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs using Spring Boot, applying API design best practices and integrating with external services, data sources and databases
* Solid expertise in Spring framework/Spring Boot design principles including core annotations, dependency injection, bean lifecycle, transaction management, and database access patterns.

* Experience with React performance optimization, including code splitting, lazy loading, memoization strategies, and efficient rendering of large data sets
* Familiarity with React build tooling, including modern bundlers (Webpack/Vite), environment configuration, and deployment optimization.

Soft Skills
  
  

* Strong communication skills with the ability to articulate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Proven experience working directly with clients and business stakeholders to clarify requirements, manage expectations, and reduce ambiguity.
* Ability to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions constructively, and drive clarity in complex or evolving problem spaces.

description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Senior Software Engineer
  
  
**Overview**
Mastercard is a technology company in the Global Payments Industry. We operate the world’s fastest payments processing network, connecting consumers, financial institutions, merchants, governments, and businesses in more than 210 countries and territories. Mastercard products and solutions make everyday commerce activities – such as shopping, travelling, running a business, and managing finances – easier, more secure, and more efficient for everyone.
  
  
MasterCard is seeking for a Senior Software Engineering to join our Data and Analytics team in building new data driven products for our consumers. The candidate will work with cross-functional teams and business stakeholders in developing product platforms. The ideal candidate should be passionate about design thinking, customer experience journey, highly motivated, intellectually curious, analytical, and possesses an entrepreneurial mindset.
  
  
Join our team and help shape the future of data and analytics!

Mastercard is building digital platform for data accessibility for different personas e.g., business-users, data engineers, for faster retrieval of data.

* Responsible for the analysis, design, development, and delivery of software solutions.
* Plan, design, and develop technical solutions and alternatives to meet business requirements in adherence with MasterCard standards, processes, and best practices.
* Independently come up with different solutions, extensible low-level design. Write modular, extensible, readable, and performant code.

* Research new frameworks and technologies, assist with prototyping and proof-of-concepts, participate in code reviews.
* Build, develop, mentor and coach junior team members.
* Collaborate with teams by contributing to the shared vision and working closely with cross-functional stakeholders.
* You will be responsible for the API’s you (and or your team) build and will support them till the time they are live in production.

**All About You**

* Excellent communication skills with the ability to communicate with all levels of management.
* Ability to build rapport and relationships.
* A record of successful delivery of software applications as an individual
* Problem solver and solution-seeking approach
* Knowledgeable – possessing the technical knowledge, market knowledge, and other specialized knowledge of the team’s problem domain.
* Hands on experience in building complex and highly scalable and performing systems.
* Solid understanding and hands-on experience in Java, J2EE, Spring, Spring Security, Spring Boot, RESTful web services
* Solid understanding and experience integrating web services.
* Exposure to building cloud ready applications (microservices)
* Exposure to Test Driven Development, Continuous Delivery, and Integration
* Must be high-energy, detail-oriented, proactive and can function under pressure in an independent environment.
* Must provide the necessary skills to have a high degree of initiative and self-motivation to drive results.
* Possesses strong communication skills -- both verbal and written – and strong relationship, collaborative skills, and organizational skills.
* Willingness and ability to learn and take on challenging opportunities and to work as a member of matrix based diverse and geographically distributed project team.
* Bachelor’s in computer degree (BE/BTech)
* 7-10 years of work experience

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

description:
**Job Description**
About Williams-Sonoma, Inc.
  
  
Founded in 1956 and headquartered in San Francisco, California, Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is a Fortune 500, digital first, multi-channel specialty retailer. Our company vision is to own the home, and the places where our customers work, stay, and play. We bring the latest home furnishing trends to life for customers through the individual lenses of our ten distinct brands, each serving different life stages and rooms of the home and beyond. Our brands include Williams Sonoma, Williams Sonoma Home, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn Teen, West Elm, Rejuvenation, Mark & Graham, GreenRow, and Dormify. We are committed to sustainability, continuously working to protect our planet, while building an open and collaborative culture across our organization.
  
  
With more than 500 retail stores globally and multiple international franchise operations, technology is a core driver of our business strategy. We build and operate in-house platforms powering e-commerce, supply chain, merchandising, analytics, and customer experience ecosystems worldwide.
  
  
Engineers at the Williams-Sonoma India Technology Center in Pune build and scale digital commerce platforms that power these global brands, serving millions of customers worldwide.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking a Software Engineer with strong expertise in Java, Microservices, and modern cloud-native development practices. This role combines enterprise software engineering with emerging Agentic AI capabilities to build scalable, intelligent solutions that improve developer productivity, automate repetitive tasks, and enhance supply chain technology platforms.
  
  
Impact of the Role
  
  
  

* Build and scale high-performance, cloud-native applications supporting critical business operations.
* Drive adoption of Agentic AI capabilities to improve engineering productivity and software quality.
* Accelerate delivery through automation of development, testing, and maintenance activities.
* Contribute to innovation initiatives that leverage AI technologies to transform supply chain and enterprise platforms.

Technology Platforms You Will Work On
  
  
  

* Java 17+
* Spring Boot
* Spring Cloud
* WebFlux
* Microservices
* Kafka
* NoSQL Technologies
* Oracle
* PostgreSQL
* Cassandra
* React
* JUnit
* Mockito
* Git
* SonarQube
* Checkstyle
* GitHub Copilot
* Cursor
* LangChain
* Semantic Kernel
* AI Agents

Key Responsibilities
  
  
  

* Engineer high-scale solutions using Java 17+, Spring Boot, WebFlux, Microservices, Kafka, and NoSQL technologies.
* Design and implement AI Agents to automate repetitive development tasks, including auto-generating boilerplate code, mapping complex DTOs, and managing script maintenance for evolving APIs.
* Ensure 100% unit testing coverage using JUnit and Mockito by leveraging LLMs to generate edge-case test scenarios and test data for complex supply chain workflows.
* Propose multiple technical solutions and evaluate how Agentic AI workflows can improve long-term system maintainability compared to traditional hard-coded approaches.
* Lead research initiatives and proof of concepts involving LangChain or Semantic Kernel to enable natural language querying of inventory and order data.
* Actively participate in Scrum ceremonies and collaborate closely with Pune and global onsite teams.
* Solve technical problems using cutting-edge technologies and industry best practices.
* Ensure code meets required development standards and is optimized for performance.
* Participate in peer code reviews using Git pull requests.
* Ensure all aspects of technical design are correctly incorporated.

**Qualifications**

* 6+ years of experience in Java/J2EE design and development with a strong focus on Spring Cloud and Microservices.
* Practical experience using AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar tools.
* Understanding of building autonomous agents to handle routine coding and development tasks.
* Proficiency in React development.
* Strong SQL experience using Oracle and PostgreSQL.
* Experience with NoSQL databases including Cassandra.
* Strong understanding of design patterns and software engineering best practices.
* Experience with code quality and static analysis tools such as SonarQube and Checkstyle.
* Experience driving automation initiatives to reduce scripting and maintenance effort.
* Good communication skills.

Why Join Williams-Sonoma India Technology Center
  
  
  

* Our people-first and performance-driven culture provides opportunities to grow and build a long-term career while supporting the well-being of our associates and their families through comprehensive benefits.
* Scale and innovation of a Fortune 500 company combined with high ownership that empowers engineers to make a real impact.
* Build and operate large-scale digital commerce platforms serving millions of customers worldwide, working on systems that run at global scale.
* Continuous learning environment with opportunities to work on cutting-edge technologies, AI-driven solutions, and large-scale engineering challenges.
* Hybrid work model designed for flexibility and collaboration, with two in-office days for team engagement.

**About Us**
**Williams-Sonoma India Pvt. Ltd.**
Founded in 1956, Williams-Sonoma Inc. is the premier specialty retailer of high-quality products for the kitchen and home in the United States. Today, Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is one of the United States' largest e-commerce retailers with some of the best known and most beloved brands in home furnishings. Our family of brands are Williams-Sonoma, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn Teens, West Elm, Williams-Sonoma Home, Rejuvenation, and Mark and Graham. We currently operate retail stores globally. Our products are also available to customers through our catalogs and online worldwide.
  
  
Williams-Sonoma India sourcing office was established in 2013. We are based in Gurugram, India. We are sourcing premium products across all categories of Home Furnishing and recorded double digit year-on-year growth. We have a dynamic team of over 100 members handling versatile vendors across India, Nepal & Bangladesh. We are looking to onboard talented people and create successful professional journey.

description:
**About Onit**
We're redefining the future of legal operations through the power of AI. Our cutting-edge platform streamlines enterprise legal management, matter management, spend management and contract lifecycle processes, transforming manual workflows into intelligent, automated solutions.
  
  
We’re a team of innovators using
**AI at the core**
to help legal departments become faster, smarter, and more strategic. As we continue to grow and expand the capabilities of our new AI-centric platform, we’re looking for bold thinkers and builders who are excited to shape the next chapter of legal tech.
  
  
If you're energized by meaningful work, love solving complex problems, and want to help modernize how legal teams operate, we’d love to meet you.
  
  
****Position Summary****
The Senior Software Engineer - Data designs and builds the data-intensive services, pipelines, and APIs that power analytics and AI features across Onit's legal operations platform, spanning enterprise legal management, matter management, spend management, and contract lifecycle management. This engineering-focused role applies strong software engineering practices to data: clean, tested, production-grade code, well-designed data models, and reliable, performant systems. Working with architects, data scientists, product managers, and fellow engineers, the Senior Software Engineer - Data owns features end to end, sets the technical approach for their area, and mentors less experienced engineers.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Data Services & Pipelines: Design, build, and own production-grade data pipelines, services, and APIs that ingest, transform, and serve data from multiple source systems to product features.
* Data Modelling: Design relational and analytical data models and schemas that keep figures consistent and performant across product surfaces, in line with the architecture defined by the Data Architect.
* Performance & Scalability: Profile and optimise queries, services, and pipelines for performance, scalability, and cost on large datasets.
* Data Quality & Reliability: Build automated tests, data validation, monitoring, and alerting so data issues are caught early, and lead troubleshooting and root-cause analysis of production issues.
* Security & Multi-Tenancy: Implement multi-tenant data isolation, access controls, and privacy safeguards such as anonymisation and aggregation thresholds.
* Engineering Excellence: Set the technical approach for features in your area, lead design and code reviews, and contribute to engineering standards, CI/CD, and documentation.
* Mentoring & Collaboration: Mentor Software Engineers, and partner with product, design, data science, and QA to deliver features from concept to production.

**Required Skills**

* 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant hands-on work building data-intensive applications, services, or pipelines in production.
* Strong proficiency in Python (or a comparable language such as Java, C#, or Ruby), with solid software engineering fundamentals: design patterns, testing, and clean, maintainable code.
* Advanced SQL and relational data modelling, including query optimisation and performance tuning on large datasets (e.g., PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or MySQL); exposure to analytical or columnar data stores.
* Experience designing and building REST APIs and backend services that expose data to product features.
* Experience building ETL/ELT pipelines, including orchestration, incremental processing, data validation, and error handling.
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred), Git-based workflows, CI/CD, and containerisation (Docker).
* Working proficiency with AI coding tools (e.g., Claude, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate development, debugging, and test writing, with the judgment to review and validate AI-generated code before it ships.
* Clear communication and the ability to mentor engineers, explain technical trade-offs, and collaborate across product and data teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with distributed data processing (e.g., Spark) or workflow orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow).
* Experience with multi-tenant SaaS systems and data isolation.
* Experience building analytics, reporting, or benchmarking features in an existing transactional product.
* Background in enterprise B2B SaaS or the legal technology domain.

**Benefits & Perks That Support You**
Onit offers a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support the whole employee at work and beyond:
  
  
Health Coverage: Employee and immediate family members.
  
  
Time Away: Flexible paid time off and 10 company paid holidays annually.
  
  
Family Support:
***Exceptional paid leave for birth parents, non-birth parents, and caregivers. Onit also offers surrogacy and adoption reimbursement.***
Income Protection:
***100% employer-paid life and disability insurance.***
Additional Coverage Options: Voluntary benefits including hospital indemnity, critical illness, accident
***.***
Tax-Advantaged Accounts:
***Flexi, NPS***
.
  
  
Community Engagement: One paid volunteer day each year to give back to the community.
  
  
**Our Commitment to Applicants**
We know that not everyone will check every box in a job description. At Onit, we value diversity, inclusion, and authenticity. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply. You may be exactly who we’re looking for.
  
  
**Onit Values**
**Customer First -**
Customer success is our success. We deliver value, listen, and act on customer needs.
  
  
**Purposeful Innovation -**
Innovation fuels our growth. We harness creativity to solve problems and lead with the intentions and expertise.
  
  
**Win as One -**
Teamwork is how we win. We are accountable, act with integrity, and communicate openly.
  
  
**Intentional Growth -**
Our people are the difference. We create an environment with compelling work, impactful contributions, and career growth.

title: Senior AI/DS Engineer
description:
**Designation :**
Senior AI/DS Engineer

**Required Experience:**

5-6 years overall with AI/ML, data science or applied AI; at least 5 years of hands-on AI/ML/data-science work and 2+ years of technical/team leadership.

**Job Description:**

Aventior is looking for a hands-on Team Lead - AI & Data Science to lead customer-facing AI and analytics engagements from discovery through production and ongoing improvement.

The role combines technical direction, people leadership, customer communication and delivery ownership. You will turn business problems into clear requirements, assess feasibility and data readiness, shape pragmatic AI/GenAI solutions, guide engineers and data scientists, and deliver secure, measurable outcomes in production.

The strongest candidate is equally comfortable discussing business value with a customer, explaining technical options and trade-offs, reviewing code or model quality, and managing scope, risks and delivery commitments.

**Key Responsibilities**

:

**1. Customer engagement, discovery and requirement gathering -**

●Lead customer and stakeholder discovery sessions, interviews and workshops to understand business goals, users, existing workflows, pain points, data sources, constraints and success criteria.

●Translate business needs into clear problem statements, functional and non-functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, assumptions, dependencies and measurable KPIs.

● Assess data availability, data quality, integration constraints, privacy/security requirements and technical feasibility before recommending an approach.

● Present solution options and trade-offs in business-friendly language, including build-versus-buy, model selection, expected value, risks, cost, latency and operational implications.

● Lead proof-of-concept planning, demos, review meetings and customer sign-off; manage clarifications, scope changes, priorities and expectation setting throughout the engagement.

**2. AI solution architecture and technical leadership**

● Own solution design across data ingestion and preparation, model or LLM selection, retrieval, orchestration, APIs, integrations, cloud infrastructure and operational monitoring.

● Choose fit-for-purpose approaches for the business problem rather than defaulting to a particular model, vendor, framework or architecture pattern.

● Establish engineering standards through design reviews, code reviews, testing practices, reusable components, documentation and secure development practices.

● Remain hands-on for critical design decisions, prototypes, complex debugging and performance/cost optimisation while enabling the team to execute independently.

**3. Generative AI, LLMs, RAG and agentic workflows**

● Design and deliver LLM-powered applications using commercial APIs and/or managed or open models; apply prompt design, structured outputs, tool/function calling and workflow orchestration as appropriate.

● Build and improve RAG pipelines, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector or hybrid retrieval, reranking, access-aware retrieval, source attribution and grounded answer generation.

● Select and apply agentic patterns only where they add value; define tool permissions, bounded actions, state transitions, approval steps, retries and safe failure behavior.

● Create systematic evaluation approaches for task success, groundedness, retrieval relevance, factuality, safety and user experience; use representative test sets, regression tests and human review where needed.

●Improve quality, latency and cost through retrieval/model comparisons, prompt and context tuning, caching, routing, token-usage controls and production feedback loops.

**4. Applied machine learning and data science**

● Guide the framing, development and validation of appropriate ML/statistical solutions such as classification, regression, forecasting, anomaly detection, clustering, NLP or optimization.

● Establish baselines and evaluation criteria; interpret results, investigate failure modes, check for data leakage and communicate limitations and confidence clearly.

● Partner with data engineers and analysts on data profiling, feature engineering, data pipelines, dataset quality, reproducibility and reliable access to data.

● Guide specialist computer-vision, OCR/intelligent document processing or multimodal work when required by the project portfolio; deep specialist research methods are not a blanket requirement for this role.

**5. Production engineering, cloud and MLOps / LLMOps**

●Build or guide production services and integrations using Python and REST APIs (FastAPI or equivalent), with appropriate validation, authentication, error handling, testing and documentation.

●Deploy and operate solutions in AWS or the agreed cloud platform. Relevant AWS services may include S3, SageMaker, Bedrock, RDS, Glue, EventBridge, Redshift, Lambda and container/orchestration services, depending on the architecture.

●Implement or oversee CI/CD, containerization, environment management, model/prompt/version tracking, automated tests, release controls, rollback and operational handover.

●Monitor application health and business/model quality, including latency, throughput, availability, cost, token consumption, retrieval quality, feedback signals and model/data drift where applicable.

● Own incident triage and root-cause analysis with engineering/platform teams; define fallback paths and support processes for customer-facing AI capabilities.

**6. Delivery management and stakeholder alignment**

●Own the delivery plan from discovery to launch: estimates, milestones, sprint/backlog priorities, resource needs, dependencies, risks, testing, UAT, release readiness and transition to support.

●Maintain a clear decision, action and risk log; provide concise progress updates; escalate issues early and propose options instead of only reporting blockers.

●Coordinate across customer teams, product/business analysts, data engineering, software engineering, QA, cloud/DevOps, security and domain experts.

●Ensure acceptance criteria and agreed business outcomes are met, and capture lessons learned and post-launch improvements

**7. Team leadership, governance and responsible AI**

● Coach and mentor AI engineers and data scientists; support work allocation, technical growth, feedback, code/model reviews and consistent quality standards.

●Apply appropriate data governance, privacy, access control, PII handling, audit logging, human review and responsible-AI safeguards based on use-case risk.

●Identify GenAI-specific risks such as prompt injection, insecure tool access, unintended data exposure, unsupported outputs and misuse; document mitigations and residual risks.

●Build reusable patterns, documentation and team practices that improve delivery predictability across multiple customer engagements

**Required Qualifications and experience:**

●5-6 years of relevant software engineering, AI/ML, data science or applied                        

AI experience, including at least 5 years of hands-on delivery experience.

●At least 2 years leading a technical team, delivery workstream or project; demonstrated ownership of technical decisions and outcomes.

●At least 2 years in customer-facing or stakeholder-facing delivery, with evidence of running discovery workshops, clarifying requirements, presenting options and managing expectations.

●Strong Python engineering and practical SQL/data skills; understanding of testing, APIs, code quality and software engineering fundamentals.

●Strong applied ML/statistical reasoning and model evaluation skills, including the ability to choose baselines, validate results and explain limitations.

●At least 2 years building GenAI/LLM applications, including practical RAG experience; able to explain architecture, evaluation, failure modes and production trade-offs. At least one production deployment is strongly preferred.

●Working experience with AWS or the target cloud platform, and with model/application deployment, CI/CD, observability and production support.

●Experience with REST APIs using FastAPI or an equivalent Python web framework, and with at least one vector database or semantic-search technology when RAG is in scope.

●Strong communication, facilitation, documentation, mentoring and problem-solving skills.

●Hands-on experience with agentic/tool-using workflows, multimodal LLMs, VLMs, or more than one model provider.

●Computer vision, OCR, intelligent document processing, object detection, image segmentation or document-understanding experience where relevant to the client pipeline.

●Experience with model fine-tuning, embedding adaptation, open-source model serving or GPU/inference optimization.

●Experience in consulting, professional services or multi-client delivery environments.

title: Data Scientist
description:
**About Onit**
We're redefining the future of legal operations through the power of AI. Our cutting-edge platform streamlines enterprise legal management, matter management, spend management and contract lifecycle processes, transforming manual workflows into intelligent, automated solutions.

**AI at the core**
to help legal departments become faster, smarter, and more strategic. As we continue to grow and expand the capabilities of our new AI-centric platform, we’re looking for bold thinkers and builders who are excited to shape the next chapter of legal tech.
  
  
If you're energized by meaningful work, love solving complex problems, and want to help modernize how legal teams operate, we’d love to meet you.
  
  
****Position Summary****
The Data Scientist owns the statistical methodology behind a new customer-facing benchmarking capability in Onit's AI-driven legal operations platform. Drawing on data from multiple source systems across enterprise legal management, matter management, and spend management, this role determines which organizations are genuinely comparable, decides where the line sits between a defensible comparison and one that is not, and ensures the product communicates confidence honestly to end users. Working closely with Product, Engineering, and the Data Architect on a Databricks-based platform, the Data Scientist sets the evidential standards, data quality targets, and governance for pooled, anonymised cross-customer analytics.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Benchmarking Methodology: Own the statistical methodology behind customer-facing benchmarking, end to end.
* Comparability Modelling: Build and validate a model that determines which organizations are genuinely comparable, using features such as service mix, pricing, scale, and geography.
* Defensibility Thresholds: Decide where the line sits between a comparison Onit can defend and one it cannot, and design the product's behaviour on both sides of it.
* Data Quality Programme: Profile data quality across multiple source systems and lead a measurable improvement programme against a defined target, partnering with Data Engineering on remediation.
* Entity Resolution: Define the approach for resolving duplicate and conflicting records across systems that were never designed to reconcile with one another.
* External Data Assessment: Assess whether missing attributes can be responsibly supplemented from external sources, and set the evidential bar for doing so.
* Governance & Privacy: Work with Product on methodology and governance for pooled, anonymised cross-customer analytics, including aggregation thresholds.
* Communicating Uncertainty: Explain uncertainty clearly to non-statisticians and help the product communicate confidence honestly to end users.

**Required Skills**

* 7+ years in applied data science, analytics engineering, or a closely related quantitative role, including ownership of methodology for externally facing analytics.
* Strong applied statistics: sampling, variance, confidence intervals, and sound judgement about small samples (e.g., able to explain why a three-item average may or may not be publishable).
* Practical, production experience with entity resolution, record linkage, deduplication, or master data management.
* Strong SQL, and Python or Ruby for analysis and modelling; hands-on experience working in Databricks (notebooks, Spark/PySpark, Delta tables) or a comparable cloud data platform.
* Experience diagnosing and remediating data quality problems at scale, including reasoning about why data is missing before deciding what to do about it.
* Rigorous validation habits: defines baselines and success metrics before building, and reports honestly against them.
* Ability to communicate uncertainty to non-technical stakeholders without overstating confidence or being unhelpfully vague.
* Working proficiency with AI tools (e.g., Claude, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate analysis, code, and documentation, with the statistical judgment to critically validate AI-generated output.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building benchmarks, rate comparisons, scoring models, or indices intended for external consumption.
* Experience with anonymisation, aggregation thresholds, or privacy-preserving analytics.
* Experience working with a cloud data warehouse or lakehouse (Databricks preferred).
* Experience in a regulated or commercially sensitive domain, ideally legal.
* Experience defining data quality SLAs or acceptance thresholds with business stakeholders.

**Benefits & Perks That Support You**

Health Coverage: Employee and immediate family members.

***Exceptional paid leave for birth parents, non-birth parents, and caregivers. Onit also offers surrogacy and adoption reimbursement.***

***100% employer-paid life and disability insurance.***
Additional Coverage Options: Voluntary benefits including hospital indemnity, critical illness, accident
***.***
Tax-Advantaged Accounts:
***Flexi, NPS***
.
  
  
Community Engagement: One paid volunteer day each year to give back to the community.

If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply. You may be exactly who we’re looking for.

**Customer First -**
Customer success is our success. We deliver value, listen, and act on customer needs.
  
  
**Purposeful Innovation -**
Innovation fuels our growth. We harness creativity to solve problems and lead with the intentions and expertise.

Teamwork is how we win. We are accountable, act with integrity, and communicate openly.

Our people are the difference. We create an environment with compelling work, impactful contributions, and career growth.

description:

Solves complex analytical problems using quantitative approaches through a combination of analytical, mathematical and technical skills. Researches, designs, implements and validates complex algorithms to analyze diverse sources of data to achieve targeted outcomes by leveraging complex statistical and predictive modeling concepts.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

Partners with Solution Architect to enable appropriate data flow/data model, development using appropriate tools/technology, rapid prototyping and informs the design of analytical products. Partners with less experienced employees on data science tools and methodologies. Clearly articulates results, methodologies and learnings to stakeholder and peer group. Continuous development and advancement of the team through knowledge sharing and collaboration.
  
  
**Competencies**
Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.
  
  
Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.
  
  
Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.
  
  
Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.
  
  
Tech savvy - Anticipating and adopting innovations in business-building digital and technology applications.
  
  
Data Mining - Extracts insights from data by identifying relationships and patterns through use of a suite of data exploration and data visualization techniques to understand the underlying structure of the data and enable sound conclusions upon model building.
  
  
Predictive Modeling - Develops analytical or machine learning models by using appropriate variable transformations, feature selection strategies, imputation strategies, class rebalancing, resampling strategies and quality control measures to generate predictive insights used in solving business questions.
  
  
Programming - Creates, writes and tests computer code, test scripts, and build scripts using algorithmic analysis and design, industry standards and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance and compliance requirements.
  
  
Requirements Analysis - Evaluates relationships and interdependencies between requirements based upon their complexity and value to the business in order to determine feasibility and prioritization.
  
  
Statistical Modeling - Develops descriptive and explanatory statistical models, and simulations for regression, classification, outlier detection, anomaly detection, time series forecasting using knowledge of foundational statistics such as null hypotheses significance tests, regression models, generalized linear modeling, time series analysis, rank statistics, probability distribution fitting survival analysis, etc. to validate hypotheses for any given statistical or business question.
  
  
Problem Solving - Solves problems and may mentor others on effective problem solving by using a systematic analysis process by leveraging industry standard methodologies to create problem traceability and protect the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; identifies the systemic root causes and ensures actions to prevent problem reoccurrence are implemented.

title: Product Intelligence, Launch & Adoption Lead
description:
**Organization Overview**
**Company Description**
QAD is building a world-class SaaS company, and we are growing. We are looking for talented individuals who want to join us on our mission to help solve relevant real-world problems in manufacturing and the supply chain.
  
  
**This hybrid position requires candidates to be based in Pune with 3-4 days of in-office collaboration per week.**
**Job Description**
QAD is hiring a senior operator to own three connected things: how we measure whether our products are working, how we launch new products into the market, and how we keep them adopted once they're live.
  
  
The role owns the metrics layer across our product portfolio — telemetry, adoption analytics, value realization — and runs the operational mechanics of every product launch. After launch, you're the person who notices when usage decays, diagnoses why, and routes the fix to the right team. You'll partner closely with the Customer Success organization, which executes the customer-facing side of adoption work under your diagnostic direction.
  
  
This is the most operationally demanding seat on the Product Operations team and the one with the most cross-functional surface area. It reports to the Head of Product Operations.
  
  
What you'll own
  
  

* Own KPI governance and the metrics layer: workflow telemetry, adoption analytics, product-health dashboards, decision outcomes vs. baseline. Standardize dual success metrics across the portfolio (product outcomes and model metrics) so teams know what "good enough" means at each capability tier.
* Own value-realization tracking: prove ROI per launched product at the customer level. This evidence does two jobs — it informs stage-gate decisions, and it underwrites the case for continued investment in the new product portfolio.
* Run NPI launch mechanics: launch readiness, enablement materials, sales and customer success playbooks, pricing-and-packaging coordination per product, and the cross-functional launch calendar.
* Own adoption health monitoring across the entire shipped portfolio. Maintain the leading-indicator dashboard. When sustained usage decay is flagged (with thresholds defined per product), trigger the adoption response protocol within 48 hours: pull evaluation signals, value-realization data, and field notes; diagnose the root cause; route to the right owner.
* Be the single accountable owner of root-cause diagnosis when adoption drops. Route product gaps to the product team, enablement gaps to Customer Success, and customer-fit issues to the field deployment team. Customer Success executes the human-side fix; you stay accountable for the signal and the routing.
* Run PM enablement: AI-native methodology, templates, the experimentation cadence, and the training that helps product managers evolve into operators of AI-powered products. Partner closely with the AI Quality & Evaluation Lead so PM training on evaluation-writing is integrated, not bolted on.
* Standardize the intake process for user feedback, feature requests, and field signals, and own the core product-ops tool stack.

**Qualifications**
What we're looking for
  
  

* 5-8 years in product ops, product launch/GTM operations, customer-success operations, or product analytics — with demonstrated ownership of at least two of the three (launch, analytics, adoption).
* Hands-on experience launching products in a multi-SKU enterprise environment; bonus if you've owned a post-launch adoption motion working with a separate Customer Success team.
* Strong analytics: dashboards, partnering with data teams to build self-serve analytics for product managers, SQL and spreadsheet automation expected.
* Strong facilitator who can hold a cross-functional diagnostic conversation. The job is calling the right meeting at the right time and making sure the right four humans are in it.
* Backbone, in a different flavor than the Head's. You will need to tell Customer Success leadership "this is not an enablement problem, please don't run that playbook" — and be right.
* Curiosity about the AI landscape; you don't need to build evaluations but you need to read them.

**Additional Information**

* Your health and well being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work-life balance.
* Opportunity to join a growing business, launching into its next phase of expansion and transformation.
* Collaborative culture of smart and hard-working people who support one another to get the job done.
* An atmosphere of growth and opportunity, where idea-sharing is always prioritized over level or hierarchy.
* Compensation packages based on experience and desired skill set

**About QAD**
QAD | Redzone is redefining manufacturing and supply chains through its intelligent, adaptive platform that connects people, processes, and data into a single System of Action. With three core pillars — Redzone (frontline empowerment), Adaptive Applications (the intelligent backbone), and Champion AI (Agentic AI for manufacturing) — QAD | Redzone helps manufacturers operate with Champion Pace, achieving measurable productivity, resilience, and growth in just 90 days.
  
  
QAD is committed to ensuring that every employee feels they work in an environment that values their contributions, respects their unique perspectives and provides opportunities for growth regardless of background. QAD’s DEI program is driving higher levels of diversity, equity and inclusion so that employees can bring their whole self to work.
  
  
We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class.

title: AI Researcher
description:
**About Intellimation.ai

Intellimation.ai builds AI that runs in production inside banks, asset managers and hedge funds. Founded in 2018 and profitable, we have 40+ autonomous workflows live at 30+ Tier-1 financial institutions across reconciliation, margin and collateral, structured products, CLO and credit, ISDA and prime brokerage agreements, and client onboarding.

We are not a model lab and we do not sell a chatbot. We work at the inference layer: a neuro-symbolic reasoning and extraction engine, built on financial-domain knowledge, that sits over any frontier or open-weight model and turns it into an auditable, governed system a regulated firm will sign off. We specialise models to each workflow, so clients get frontier-level accuracy on infrastructure they control.

Our line is simple: proof, not pilots. If you want your research to end up in front of a bank's model-risk committee rather than in a demo, this is the place.

The role

You will own the research that makes our inference layer more accurate, more reliable and easier to audit, and you will carry that research into production yourself. This is applied work on live financial documents and data, not a lab seat.

What you will do:

• Design and run the evaluation harnesses that decide whether a workflow ships: task-level accuracy, failure taxonomies, regression suites, and the evidence a bank's model-risk team asks for.

• Specialise models to individual financial workflows and show they match the frontier model on the same task at a fraction of the cost.

• Improve the extraction and reasoning methods behind multi-document, multi-hop extraction and validation on contracts, term sheets, confirmations and broker feeds.

• Build the monitoring and retraining methods that keep a deployed workflow accurate as documents and counterparties change.

• Benchmark frontier and open-weight models on our workflows and turn the results into clear recommendations on what we run where.

• Work directly with our engineering pods and product leads to move methods from notebook to production, and write them up so clients, auditors and the rest of the team can follow what was done and why.

You will see your work in front of Tier-1 clients within months, not years.

What we are looking for

Must have:

• Hands-on experience fine-tuning, distilling or evaluating LLMs, with results you can point to — not only prompting.

• Strong Python and the modern stack: PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, PEFT or similar, vLLM or comparable serving, and the tooling to make experiments reproducible.

• Rigour in experimental design and evaluation: you build the harness before you build the model, and you can explain a result to a sceptical reviewer.

• Solid foundation in statistics, machine learning and software engineering; comfortable with large, messy, unstructured datasets.

• NLP depth: information extraction, document understanding, retrieval and structured-output methods.

• Clear written and spoken communication; able to work in a small cross-functional pod and own outcomes.

• Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Electrical Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Strong plus:

• Published work or open-source contributions on evaluation, distillation, structured extraction or neuro-symbolic methods.

• Experience with model governance in a regulated setting: model-risk documentation, validation evidence, lineage.

• Familiarity with financial documents and data — trade confirmations, ISDA or prime brokerage agreements, term sheets, reconciliation breaks, margin calls.

• Experience running models on dedicated infrastructure rather than only on hosted APIs.

Location and travel

Full-time, based in Pune, with frequent travel to London and New York to work alongside clients' and partners' research teams. Expect regular stretches on site in both cities.

You will work alongside senior leaders with 125+ years of combined experience building and selling for financial services, in a profitable company with no pressure to chase a pilot that will never ship.**

title: Senior Delivery Management Leader - AI productivity solutions
description:
We're seeking a Senior Delivery Management Leader focused on AI productivity solutions to steer the successful rollout of high-value AI programs across enterprise client accounts.

This position demands substantial expertise spanning AI, cloud platforms, and application development, along with the capability to direct large, geographically dispersed teams and oversee intricate client portfolios.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Manage the complete delivery lifecycle for client engagements, spanning strategic planning, execution, governance, and post-launch support
* Confirm that delivery benchmarks, including scope, timeline adherence, quality standards, budget management, and operational KPIs, are consistently achieved across engagements
* Direct portfolios containing multiple projects and substantial cross-functional teams, promoting collaboration among engineering, QA, business analysis, architecture, and DevOps functions
* Take ownership of program governance structures (SteerCo, WSR, MSR), keeping stakeholders at every level informed and aligned on deliverables and risk factors
* Bear full responsibility for the financial performance of the client portfolio, covering revenue recognition, profitability, margin growth, budget projections, and corrective planning
* Pinpoint opportunities to reduce costs and drive down OPEX through automation, better resource allocation, or improved delivery approaches
* Track resource allocation and productivity indicators spanning multiple concurrent projects
* Act as the key point of contact for senior client relationships (Directors, VPs, CXOs), converting business challenges into practical delivery strategies
* Assemble, direct, and mentor sizable distributed teams of 100 to 150+ professionals spread across nearshore, offshore, and onshore locations, building strong teams and supporting talent growth
* Resolve resource conflicts and escalations while safeguarding delivery timelines, proactively spotting, evaluating, and addressing program-level risks
* Prepare contingency plans backed by solid mitigation tactics and escalation processes to maintain service continuity during demanding periods
* Spot opportunities for up-sell and cross-sell within existing accounts, craft strategies to grow organizational presence, and work with sales and pre-sales teams on RFPs, SOWs, and proposals
* Partner with Account Managers to translate successful delivery results into expanded client engagement and pursue new business by highlighting delivery leadership and engineering strength
* Foster continuous innovation across client projects through automation, process refinement, and adoption of emerging technology, spreading best practices throughout delivery teams
* Direct comprehensive AI program delivery, covering Agentic AI and AI productivity solution execution, deployment of AI accelerators, and establishing measurable KPIs to monitor and enhance delivery efficiency via AI on AWS and Azure platforms

**Requirements**

* Between 15 and 18 years of IT background, including more than 8 years in delivery leadership positions and over 3 years working on AI/ML initiatives
* Demonstrated success delivering enterprise-level AI programs, covering LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI, and automation applications
* Thorough understanding of cloud-native AI services available on AWS or Azure
* Strong background managing large-scale enterprise programs across sectors such as BFSI, Telecom, Healthcare, Retail, or Life Sciences
* Proven capability influencing and managing senior client stakeholders (Directors, VPs, CXOs) while establishing trust-based relationships
* Practical leadership style suited to resolving escalations, managing internal team conflicts, and navigating program obstacles effectively
* Working knowledge of modern engineering tools and delivery approaches, including cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), microservices and DevOps practices, analytics tools (Tableau, Power BI, BigQuery), and automation frameworks such as RPA (UiPath, Blue Prism)
* Familiarity with ITIL/ITSM frameworks and SLA-based managed services delivery
* Background in Agile methodologies (Scrum, SAFe) as well as traditional Waterfall delivery approaches
* Outstanding leadership, negotiation, and decision-making skills suited to managing high-pressure scenarios and improving delivery outcomes
* Capability to operate effectively amid uncertainty and deliver results despite demanding timelines
* Strong analytical thinking, communication skills, and interpersonal abilities that support collaboration with teams and clients alike

title: Senior Java Developer - Assistant Vice President
description:

The overall objective of this role is to contribute to applications systems analysis and programming activities.
  
  
Finance Desk Technology is part of Markets Technology. The Team works closely with the Citi Global Finance Desk and Markets Treasury Desks. The suite of Finance Desk applications provides position management, trade capture, electronic trading, market risk processing and reporting. This is supported by a mixed technology environment consisting of client-server applications, developed in Java, Angular and C#, with services running on Linux servers and Cloud Containers. This provides unique opportunity to work closely with the business stakeholders while building towards the strategic technology roadmap. We are looking for technically strong candidates who can work as team players and capable of taking ownership and leading the initiatives when needed.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities / Role:**

* Responsible for developing and maintaining suite of applications as a part of global development team.
* Production of high-quality software, emphasizing simplicity, maintainability and reuse, using standard development process.
* Understands business priorities, documents requirements and determines solutions in partnership with other internal teams.
* Accountable for all phases of development process—analysis, design, construction, testing and implementation; provides user and operational support on applications to business users.
* Ensures essential procedures are followed and helps to define operating standards and processes.
* Participating in key business initiatives involving multiple workstreams.
* Coordinate global testing and schedule application rollouts.
* Contribute towards improving the Dev Ops CI/CD Pipelines and Strategic Architecture.
* Work closely with partner technology teams and to collaborate effectively.
* Monitor and control all phases of development process and analysis, design, construction, testing, and implementation as well as provide user and operational support on applications to business users.
* Provide L3 support for production flows.
* Utilize in-depth specialty knowledge of applications development to analyze complex problems/issues, provide evaluation of business process, system process, and industry standards, and make evaluative judgement
* Recommend and develop security measures in post implementation analysis of business usage to ensure successful system design and functionality
* Ensure essential procedures are followed and help define operating standards and processes
* Serve as advisor or coach to new or lower level analysts

description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Technology Consulting**
**Title: Application Engineer - III**
EY is a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services. Technology is at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and are key to our innovation as an organization.
  
  
Fueled by strategic investment in technology and innovation, Client Technology seeks to drive growth opportunities and solve complex business problems for our clients through building a robust platform for business and powerful product engine that are vital to innovation at scale. As part of Client Technology, you’ll work with technologists and business experts, blending EY’s deep industry knowledge and innovative ideas with our platforms, capabilities, and technical expertise. As a catalyst for change and growth, you’ll be at the forefront of integrating emerging technologies from AI to Data Analytics into every corner of what we do at EY. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact.
  
  
**EY Technology:**
Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.
  
  
**EY Technology**
supports our technology needs through three business units:
  
  
**Client Technology (CT) -**
focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology-based opportunities faster and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.
  
  
**Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) –**
EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit-for-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.
  
  
**Information Security (Info Sec) -**
Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.
  
  
**The opportunity**
This role provides advanced-level system analysis, design, development, and implementation of applications and databases under general direction, and leads front-end and back-end technologies, ensuring the functionality and user experience of the web solutions. The role requires a very strong understanding of front-end frameworks and back-end logic integration, optimization, data integration, documentation, and secure, scalable architecture aligned with enterprise standards.
